name: Chart
purpose: Visualizes a metric with a token-branded, accessible chart so people can understand trends, comparisons, composition, or events.
neverUseFor: Raw ECharts options or a product-specific chart renderer
Precise audit values without an accompanying Table
rationale: Chart wraps the charting engine behind a token-branded API (ADR-021) so series colors, axes and typography come from --helix-* tokens rather than raw library options, and every chart ships with a labelled data table for 1.1.1 Non-text Content. Consumers describe the metric; Helix owns the rendering, palette and accessibility.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the chart type and data series from the documented props
Pair a Chart with a Table for precise audit values
Compose Charts inside Cards to build dashboards
mustEscalateToDS: Passing raw engine options or a product-specific renderer
Adding new chart types or series colors outside the token palette

anatomy.description: Apache ECharts canvas with accessible name.
Visually hidden source-data table for non-visual access.
